blocking_finding.detail: Engine-002 reads DGP-002 nuisance coefficients for baseline_action/domain/operationalisation/presentation, but hard-codes the profile_action_formula coefficient 0.04. DGP-002 requires the exact logit equation to be consumed without conflicting hard-coded coefficients. Therefore the required pre-Monte-Carlo audit cannot PASS yet.

required_fix: Represent the DGP profile_action term as a canonical DGP parameter and consume it from the frozen DGP artifact, then rerun implementation-equivalence and dry-run audits.
